static_traits.name: Li Bo
static_traits.social_status: 有一群支持性的朋友,但Interpersonal relationships因其灾难化倾向而紧张;尚not yet与朋友讨论其认知模式
static_traits.medical_history: 既往without类似心理问题史;not yet接受过心理治疗;without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度Good;语气偏消极;能自我Reflection但常use绝对化表述,易聚焦负面并忽略正面

basic_info.main_problem: 倾向于将小挫折灾难化并全盘negate整段体验(如A shell picked up at the beach cracking in the car就认为整趟旅行毫Meaninglessness),该模式约一年前开始并近来加重,常在事情not如计划时出现,导致忽视积极,只关注负面.
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到灾难化倾向正在影响整体人生观并造成not必要的痛苦,因此寻求咨询;希望能提醒自己'一件小事not会毁掉一切'.
growth_experiences: 约一年前在个人生活中遭遇一系列小挫折(如朋友取消计划,丢失喜欢的小物品等),此后在小事上逐渐形成并Reinforcement灾难化与非黑即白的认知模式:一旦出现not完美就全盘negate整体体验.该模式使其越来越忽视积极面,只聚焦负面,进而影响睡眠与自我照护,Work与Interpersonal relationships.

core_beliefs: One negative event ruins the whole experience

special_situations.event: A shell picked up at the beach cracking in the car
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现瑕疵,就说明这一天not再完美,整趟旅行也失去意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 将注意力聚焦在负面细节,negate或忽略其他积极体验以维持对'完美'的标准

special_situations.event: Friends canceling plans at the last minute
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the plan is disrupted, it means life is going downhill and I have lost control
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 预先negate后续安排,扩大负面影响以求'心理准备'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everything is collapsing; this week is ruined

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能保持事物完好和掌控,就说明我not称职/失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加重自责并negate当天其他收获,减少对正面事实的关注
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I always mess things up,什么都留not住

special_situations.event: Work中出现小偏差或课程not yet按计划进行
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果课程not是完美的,就意味着我not称职,not值得肯定
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on negative feedback or small mistakes, actively ignores the positive parts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这节课很糟,我not是好教练

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain perfection and control, thereby gaining a stable sense of worth and pleasurable experience
core_conflict.fear: 害怕一旦出现not完美就意味着彻底失败与被negate,生活失控
defense_goal: 通过全盘negate与绝对化评价来避免面对not完美的Anxiety
Maintains a focus on negative details to uphold the psychological defense line of a 'perfect standard'

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile self, easily knocked down by small setbacks, needs perfection to maintain a sense of worth
object_relations.object_representation: 他人可能not理解或会评判自己,世界/情境容易'破坏'完美计划

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当发生小挫折或not如计划(如物品损坏,计划被取消)时,或当他人邀请其关注积极面/整合好坏并存时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将not完美理解为全面失败与失控(移情:将'完美=安全'的内在规则Projection到情境)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use绝对化表述(如'全都毁了'),deny或轻视正面细节,语气Depression并坚持'要么完美要么毫Meaninglessness'的立场.

manifestations: 当出现小缺陷(如贝壳裂开)时,将整段体验定义为'毫Meaninglessness'
以'完美的一天'为意义锚点,导致意义感对not完美高度脆弱

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Evaluates experiences by the rigid rule 'should have a perfect day'
Constrains oneself with the inner standard 'one small thing ruins everything'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 明知有支持性朋友却not讨论自身困扰,将压力与负面反刍留给自己
When distressed, reduces outward expression and support-seeking and instead turns to self-depletion (sleep and self-care are impaired)

positive_force: Has a supportive network of friends
曾主动尝试正念Intervention以挑战思维
Has self-awareness, can describe clearly and is willing to seek help
有稳定职业skill与Work基础(Yoga instructor)
negative_force: Cognitive tendencies toward catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking显著
心理过滤与negate积极,难以看到正面事实
担心被评价而not向支持者表达困扰
完美主义的价值条件导致对not确定性耐受差
Negative rumination impairs sleep and self-care

target_behavior.behavior: 在小挫折后出现Catastrophizing and black-and-white cognitive reactions(伴随Low mood)
antecedent: Small defects or damage appearing (e.g. a cracked shell)
Having plans cancelled by friends or losing a beloved item
target_behavior.core_reason: 内化的完美主义规则与'not完美=失败'的核心信念
target_behavior.function: 通过全盘negate体验来逃避not完美与not确定带来的Anxiety与羞耻感
target_behavior.consequence: Ignoring the positive side, work and interpersonal relations are impaired, sleep and self-care are disturbed, overall suffering worsens

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids seeking support from friends or discussing cognitive troubles
antecedent: After negative emotions or catastrophizing thoughts arise
担心被认为夸大或not被理解时
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被评判与negate,保持脆弱自我形象的防御性回避
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential negative evaluation to maintain a sense of psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统not yet被利用,Interpersonal relationships进一步紧张,负性情绪与认知反刍积累
